description: Integration: promoteBundleMasterAction still promotes a child (settings row moved, children re-pointed, old master becomes child) and still rejects a non-child and a ticket with children of its own

Integration: bundleTicketsAction with masterTicketId = a new ticket and children including an existing master yields one bundle whose master is the requested ticket, with the old bundle's mode and reopen_on_child_reply; a failure in the promote step leaves the original bundle untouched
Integration: bundleTicketsAction with two existing masters among the listed tickets is rejected and changes nothing

Component: BulkBundleDialog with one existing master renders the dropdown enabled with the existing master selected and the new notice; choosing another member submits it as masterTicketId; with two existing masters the dropdown is disabled

Playwright: on a child ticket's page, Make master then confirm shows the master banner on that ticket and lists the former master as a child; Promote on a master's page asks for confirmation and cancel changes nothing
